messages.author: b7fd96641f554fce
messages.subject: question on working dir
parts:
Hi:
In Win7 when opening a file (something like: D:/mydat/xyz.r) with Tinn-R in my laptop, then opening Rgui through Tinn-R, the working directory I get in Rconsole is 'D:/mydat'. But on my PC the same commands yield the directory where R is located i.e. C:/prog..../bin/x64. Where could I change this last path to get the one of my laptop? Thanks a lot for any answer.
Gilbert.

messages.author: eed7c15a4e3232e7
messages.subject: RE: question on working dir
parts:
send the following command to R:
setwd('D:/mydat')

Or if you work in a script on your PC as well, press the little Working Directory button in TinnR (looks like a gray suitcase tag)

regards,
Berry

messages.author: 18092322a527b40b
messages.subject: Re: question on working dir
parts:
@GMarzolin,

Tinn-R always automatically sets the R workdir to the path of the current script (if a file is opened) when starting R and it (an feature) is not user configurable yet. We can make it user configurable (in the next version to be released in few weeks with lot of news). Let us know if it is desirable

But, if you want to start R in the default workdir you have two options:
1- To start R (Rgui or Rterm) inside of Tinn-R without any file opened;
2- To start Rgui of side of Tinn-R.

HTH,
J.C.Faria

Hi JC,
Customizing whether to setwd is kind of nice, but not really worth a lot of effort, in my opinion.

As it seems you're working towards an update, I have a question about the syntax highlighting:
h, angle, br, tmag (old!), prob, ... are highlighted as par arguments (pink, Reserved_3).
Shouldn't that only be happening for everything that is in graphics:::.Pars?

Also, when the cursor is at the end of a command, pressing F1 doesn't call help(wordofcursorposition), but yields the error "No valid word selected!" Same thing with F2 (str).

This was Tinn-R 3.0.2.7, so if it is already changed in the newer versions, please just disregard this message.

Are there still plans for a linux release?
I would be willing to test a beta version or do whatever else I can to help.

regards,
Berry

messages.author: 18092322a527b40b
messages.subject: Re: question on working dir
parts:
Em sexta-feira, 19 de dezembro de 2014 06h06min28s UTC-3, Berry Boessenkool escreveu:

Hi JC,
Customizing whether to setwd is kind of nice, but not really worth a lot of effort, in my opinion.
We will add it to make the tools still more user configurable.

As it seems you're working towards an update, I have a question about the syntax highlighting:
h, angle, br, tmag (old!), prob, ... are highlighted as par arguments (pink, Reserved_3).
Shouldn't that only be happening for everything that is in graphics:::.Pars?
For this family of reserved words we made a collection of the main arguments of plot functions of the main packages, not only graphics:::.Pars
Also, when the cursor is at the end of a command, pressing F1 doesn't call help(wordofcursorposition), but yields the error "No valid word selected!" Same thing with F2 (str).
I will try to improve this feature: thanks por pointing it out.

This was Tinn-R 3.0.2.7, so if it is already changed in the newer versions, please just disregard this message.

Are there still plans for a linux release?
With new versions of Delphi we can compile the Tinn-R only for Windows, Mac and Android, not for Linux. Additionally, this will not be a trivial task. So we have plans but in the long term.
I would be willing to test a beta version or do whatever else I can to help.

Thanks, I will sent for you as soon as possible.

Best,
J.C.Faria
